flawed_step: 0120 | The claimed equivalence “∂²=0 iff (q+1)r=0 for all r∈R” is false for an arbitrary q-complex as defined.
counterexample: Let X consist only of the zero subspace and take R=ℤ. Then ∂²=0 vacuously because X has no 2-dimensional faces, but (q+1)·1≠0 in ℤ.
assessment_summary: The reverse implication requires the complex to contain a two-dimensional subspace. No such hypothesis is present, so the proof fails at step 0120.
